test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: In which part of the excretory system of the human body urine is it stored before passing urine?
solution:
__
 
• The urine is stored in the **urinary bladder**__ before passing out.
 
• The **urethra **is a tube that connects the urinary bladder to the urethral meatus.
 
• **91-96% of urine consists of water** it also includes proteins, hormones and salts
 
• Urine is pale yellow due to the result of a pigment called __**urochrome.**__
 
• The ureter carries urine from the kidneys to the urinary bladder.
 
• Bowman's Capsule helps in the** filtration of blood to form urine.**
